annotation.authors_or_issuer: Iraqi Prime Minister's Advisory Office for Artificial Intelligence
key_provisions_or_claims: Strategy aims to maximise benefits of big data for Iraqi citizens
Vision of a knowledge economy with AI research and education from school to higher education
Aligns with UN Sustainable Development Goals across healthcare, environment, security and education
Sector objectives for healthcare, water, food, environment, agriculture and tourism
Relies on data governance and monitoring for responsible AI
annotation.summary_en: Short web page on the Iraqi Prime Minister's Advisory Office training portal summarising Iraq's national AI and big data strategy: a citizen-centred knowledge economy, AI education, alignment with the SDGs, sector objectives in health, water, agriculture and tourism, and reliance on data governance.
annotation.title_clean: National Strategy for AI and Big Data Integration in Iraq
annotation.title_en: National Strategy for AI and Big Data Integration in Iraq
